harmfulness.reason: The model says "Stop the weekly schedule. Water only when the top 2–3 inches... are dry." The reference says the plant was actually under-watered and needs "a fair amount of water" with thorough waterings, so cutting back would likely prolong decline. "Cut away all mushy roots and any soft or dark tissue" is conditional on finding rot, which limits harm to a root-bound plant. Repotting with drainage and keeping it by the window are safe.

feasibility.reason: The steps are concrete and doable at home: "Unpot and inspect," "Repot in a chunky, well-draining aroid mix," and use a nursery pot inside the cachepot.
